intentionalRemainders: Any unused dry spices/condiments remain as cupboard stock.
Unused pumpkin/sunflower seeds, coffee and dark chocolate remain for breakfasts/snacks.
Any unused nappies, paracetamol and Method spray remain as household stock.
usefulNotes: Dinner-derived lunches are identical complete portions of the source dinner.
Wednesday dinner includes 2 adult portions for Thursday work lunches.
Thursday dinner is adults only because Barney eats at nursery and includes 2 adult portions for Friday work lunches.
Protein quantities have been deliberately scaled to avoid undersized adult portions.

mon-lunch.title: Jacket potato with baked beans, feta & salad
method: Bake potatoes until crisp and fluffy.
Heat beans thoroughly.
Split potatoes, top with beans and feta; serve lettuce and tomatoes alongside.
mon-lunch.flavourNote: Season the potato well; feta adds salt and tang.
mon-lunch.barneyNote: Serve Barney a smaller potato portion; chop salad appropriately.

mon-dinner.title: Lemon, garlic & feta chicken traybake with couscous and tenderstem broccoli

portions.allocation: Marcus + Bron + Barney dinner; 2 complete adult portions for Tuesday lunch

method: Heat oven to 210C/190C fan.
Toss chicken with lemon zest/juice, garlic, oregano, olive oil, salt and pepper; roast until cooked through.
Add tenderstem for the final 12–15 minutes.
Prepare couscous with hot stock/water; fluff well.
Serve every portion with chicken, couscous and broccoli; divide two complete portions into lunch containers.
ingredients: remaining feta if available after lunch
mon-dinner.flavourNote: Use plenty of lemon, oregano, garlic and black pepper; finish with feta if any remains.
mon-dinner.barneyNote: Keep Barney's chicken lightly salted and cut appropriately.
mon-dinner.storageNote: Cool lunch portions promptly; refrigerate and reheat until piping hot.

arrangeForLunch.label: Tuesday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack 2 identical complete portions: chicken, couscous and broccoli.

tue-lunch.title: Lemon, garlic & feta chicken traybake with couscous and tenderstem broccoli
method: Reheat the two complete portions prepared with Monday dinner until piping hot.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Identical complete portion from previous dinner

tue-dinner.title: Slow-cooker beef & apricot Moroccan tagine with couscous

portions.allocation: Marcus + Bron + Barney dinner; 2 complete adult portions for Wednesday lunch

method: Brown beef if time allows, then add to slow cooker.
Add onions, garlic, tomato purée, tomatoes, stock, apricots and spices.
Cook LOW 7–8 hours or HIGH 4–5 hours until tender.
Taste and balance with lemon, salt and pepper; reduce uncovered briefly if too loose.
Prepare couscous and divide tagine plus couscous across dinner and two lunch portions.
tue-dinner.flavourNote: The finish matters: lemon should brighten the sweet apricot and rich beef; season until savoury rather than sweet.
tue-dinner.barneyNote: Remove Barney's portion before final heavy seasoning; ensure beef is very tender.
tue-dinner.storageNote: Cool two complete portions promptly; refrigerate overnight.

arrangeForLunch.label: Wednesday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack 2 identical complete portions of tagine and couscous.

wed-lunch.title: Slow-cooker beef & apricot Moroccan tagine with couscous
method: Reheat the complete portions until piping hot.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Identical complete portion from previous dinner

wed-dinner.title: Creamy Tuscan-style sausage rigatoni with spinach, tomato & Parmesan

portions.allocation: Marcus + Bron + Barney dinner; 2 complete adult portions for Thursday work lunches

method: Remove sausage meat from skins and brown deeply.
Soften onion and garlic; add fennel, oregano and tomatoes and simmer.
Cook rigatoni just shy of al dente.
Stir cream and spinach into sauce, then pasta and Parmesan; loosen with pasta water.
Divide two complete portions for Thursday before serving dinner.
wed-dinner.flavourNote: Brown the sausage properly; fennel, Parmesan and black pepper provide savoury depth. Keep enough acidity from the tomatoes to prevent the cream becoming heavy.
wed-dinner.barneyNote: Serve Barney a smaller portion; cut pasta/sausage as needed and avoid extra salt.
wed-dinner.storageNote: Refrigerate lunch portions promptly; reheat thoroughly with a splash of water.

arrangeForLunch.label: Thursday work lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack 2 identical complete portions of sausage rigatoni.

thu-lunch.title: Creamy Tuscan-style sausage rigatoni with spinach, tomato & Parmesan
method: Reheat the two complete portions until piping hot.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Identical complete portion from previous dinner

thu-dinner.title: Teriyaki salmon rice bowls with cucumber, edamame & sesame

portions.allocation: Marcus + Bron dinner; 2 complete adult portions for Friday work lunches; Barney at nursery

method: Cook rice and edamame.
Mix teriyaki, soy, rice vinegar and ginger; glaze salmon and bake or pan-cook until just cooked.
Slice cucumber and spring onions.
Build four identical complete bowls with rice, salmon, edamame and cucumber; finish with sesame.
Pack two complete bowls for Friday.
thu-dinner.flavourNote: Keep the sauce glossy and savoury; rice vinegar and ginger stop the teriyaki becoming overly sweet.
thu-dinner.storageNote: Cool rice rapidly and refrigerate promptly. Reheat rice/salmon thoroughly; keep cucumber separate if preferred.

arrangeForLunch.label: Friday work lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack 2 identical complete salmon rice bowls; do not add or transform components for lunch.

fri-lunch.title: Teriyaki salmon rice bowls with cucumber, edamame & sesame
method: Reheat the prepared complete portions safely until piping hot; serve with their cucumber component.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Identical complete portion from previous dinner

fri-dinner.title: Slow-cooker chicken shawarma with flatbreads, chopped salad & tahini-lemon sauce

portions.allocation: Marcus + Bron + Barney dinner; 2 complete adult portions for Saturday lunch

method: Coat chicken with spices, garlic and oil; slow cook LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
Shred or slice chicken and, if possible, crisp briefly under a hot grill.
Mix tahini with lemon juice and enough water for a pourable sauce.
Chop salad and warm flatbreads.
Assemble dinner and pack two complete lunch portions with the same chicken, breads, salad and sauce.
fri-dinner.flavourNote: Cumin, coriander, paprika, garlic and lemon should be assertive; crisping the cooked chicken adds important texture.
fri-dinner.barneyNote: Set aside lightly seasoned tender chicken for Barney; serve deconstructed with suitable pieces.
fri-dinner.storageNote: Refrigerate chicken, salad and sauce separately but together as complete allocated lunch meals.

arrangeForLunch.label: Saturday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve two complete identical shawarma meals: chicken, flatbreads, salad and tahini-lemon sauce.

sat-lunch.title: Slow-cooker chicken shawarma with flatbreads, chopped salad & tahini-lemon sauce
method: Reheat chicken thoroughly; serve with the reserved flatbreads, salad and tahini-lemon sauce exactly as Friday dinner.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Identical complete portion from previous dinner

sat-dinner.title: Beef burgers with seasoned potato wedges, slaw & corn
method: Cut potatoes into wedges, season with paprika, oil, salt and pepper and roast until crisp.
Shape mince into three burgers without overworking; season just before cooking.
Cook burgers through as appropriate for the family and toast buns.
Cook corn and serve with slaw and mustard.
sat-dinner.flavourNote: Good browning on the burgers and crisp wedges matter more than extra sauces.
sat-dinner.barneyNote: Cook Barney's burger fully; serve a smaller portion and cut safely.

sun-lunch.title: Kimchi sesame egg fried rice
method: Cook rice ahead and cool, or use freshly cooked rice allowed to steam dry.
Stir-fry kimchi and spring onion, add rice and peas, then push aside and scramble eggs.
Combine with soy and sesame oil; finish with sesame seeds.
sun-lunch.flavourNote: Use kimchi for acidity and heat, sesame for nuttiness and soy for savoury depth.
sun-lunch.barneyNote: For Barney, make a mild portion before adding much kimchi/soy.

sun-dinner.title: Roast pork loin with roast potatoes, carrots, greens, gravy & mustard

portions.allocation: Marcus + Bron + Barney dinner; 2 complete adult portions for Monday lunch

method: Roast pork according to joint size until safely cooked, then rest well.
Roast potatoes until deeply crisp and roast/steam carrots and greens.
Make gravy from roasting juices plus stock/granules.
Serve with mustard; reserve two complete portions including pork, potatoes, carrots, greens and gravy for Monday.
sun-dinner.flavourNote: Rest the pork properly and use roasting juices in the gravy; mustard supplies acidity and heat.
sun-dinner.barneyNote: Serve tender pork in age-appropriate pieces and keep salt modest.
sun-dinner.storageNote: Cool two complete Monday lunch portions promptly and refrigerate.

arrangeForLunch.label: Monday lunch (next week)
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack 2 identical complete roast portions with pork, potatoes, carrots, greens and gravy.
